title: List of standard templates & artworks (07.11)
slide_intent: Route people to templates that suit their tools and production task so they can modify an appropriate master.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can support local offices and professional designers with different file types while keeping the same artwork available to both.
demonstration: A format note explains PNG and EPS. A list of Office templates sits beside ruled professional asset lists covering marks, palette, stationery, banners and clothing.
practical_value: Choose an Office template for a locally editable letter or report. For custom print, consult the professional list and its cross-references for the appropriate master.

content_islands.name: Format notes
content_islands.spec: Use the left column for the roles of PNG and EPS, including the scalability of EPS artwork.

content_islands.name: Office templates
content_islands.spec: Group letterhead, presentation, fact sheet and report cover together. Name the file type and available page reference beside each.

content_islands.name: Professional artwork index
content_islands.spec: Run the professional assets across the two right columns. Separate entries with rules and keep the application or master-file information attached to its asset.
